summary: Community installs stop failing the access review job, and the hybrid worker recovers from a bad update by itself.

fixes.title: Community access review job no longer fails
fixes.text: Community installations no longer fail the access review job every run; it starts only where the edition includes it.

fixes.title: Hybrid worker undoes a bad self-update
fixes.text: After each self-update the hybrid worker tests itself and returns to the previous version if the test fails. This is recorded and shown in its status.

fixes.title: Identity move copies only needed rights
fixes.text: Each role gets only the rights it needs, and the move waits for directory delays before it checks the result.

fixes.title: Engine Azure rights can be narrowed
fixes.text: The engine's User Access Administrator right can be trimmed to the scopes PIM Manager manages.
